description: This PHP source file defines the RefreshTokenRepository class, which implements the repository interface for managing OAuth refresh tokens within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for persisting, revoking, and checking the status of refresh tokens, interacting with the database via Doctrine ORM.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth refresh tokens, providing methods to persist, revoke, and verify refresh tokens, extending BaseDao and implementing the RefreshTokenRepositoryInterface.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Persists a new refresh token entity into the database, converting the provided interface into an OAuthRefreshToken entity and handling potential unique constraint violations.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Marks a specific refresh token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a particular refresh token has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of RefreshTokenEntity.
